title: Context Compaction for World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.38980v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World models let observers explore and interact with generated worlds. Recent work shows that when observers revisit a region, current models often fail to regenerate it consistently. We view this as a context retrieval problem. LLM agents manage context retrieval at two layers of their stack. At the model layer, the KV cache design determines how much context fits in memory. At the agent harness layer, harnesses such as Claude Code pick the context sent to the LLM. Prior work on world models has mostly focused only on the model layer. In this paper, we make three contributions. First, we build a benchmark to measure world model context retrieval. It generates new worlds for every episode, preventing a model from recalling rooms using training data. It also separates context retrieval from guesses based on nearby frames. translated_title: 世界模型的上下文压缩
translated_abstract: 世界模型让观察者能够探索生成的世界并与之交互。近期研究表明，当观察者重新访问某个区域时，当前模型往往无法一致地重新生成该区域。我们将此视为一个上下文检索问题。LLM智能体在其技术栈的两个层面管理上下文检索：在模型层，KV缓存的设计决定了内存中能容纳多少上下文；在智能体框架层，诸如Claude Code之类的框架会选择发送给LLM的上下文。此前关于世界模型的工作大多只关注模型层。在本文中，我们做出了三项贡献。首先，我们构建了一个衡量世界模型上下文检索能力的基准，它为每个回合生成新世界，从而防止模型利用训练数据回忆房间，并将上下文检索与基于邻近帧的猜测区分开来。其次，我们构建了一个为世界模型执行上下文压缩的智能体框架，据我们所知，此前没有相关研究（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个衡量世界模型上下文检索能力的基准，并首次构建了为世界模型执行上下文压缩的智能体框架，以解决模型重新访问区域时无法一致重新生成的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a benchmark for measuring world model context retrieval and builds, to the authors' knowledge, the first agent harness that performs context compaction for world models, addressing inconsistent regeneration when observers revisit a region.
